chunk:
description: |
  Canonical change order entity for construction/contracting integrations.
  Represents a modification to a signed contract or in-progress job.
  Maps from: construction ERP (ComputerEase, Procore), contractor portals, CRM.
  Maps to: billing systems, ERP job cost updates, customer notification systems.

required:
  - changeOrderId
  - jobId
  - contractId
  - status
  - requestedDate
  - timestamps

properties:
  changeOrderId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical change order identifier
    example: "CO-2026-000565-001"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    properties:
      erpChangeOrderId:  { type: string }
      salesforceId:      { type: string }
      portalId:          { type: string }

  jobId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-job

  contractId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-contract being modified

  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-customer

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [REQUESTED, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPLIED, CANCELLED]

  reason:
    type: string
    description: Reason for the change order

  description:
    type: string
    description: Detailed description of what is changing

  changes:
    type: object
    properties:
      scopeChange:      { type: string, description: "Description of scope change" }
      additionalWork:   { type: string }
      materialChange:   { type: string }

  financialImpact:
    type: object
    properties:
      additionalAmount:  { type: number, description: "Positive = additional cost to customer" }
      creditAmount:      { type: number, description: "Positive = credit back to customer" }
      netChange:         { type: number }
      revisedTotal:      { type: number, description: "New contract total after change order" }
      currency:          { type: string, pattern: "^[A-Z]{3}$", example: "USD" }

  approvedB
